# Pull Request

## Description
Please include a summary of the change and the motivation.

Fixes # (issue)

## Type of Change
- [ ] feat: New feature
- [ ] fix: Bug fix
- [ ] docs: Documentation update
- [ ] refactor: Code refactor
- [ ] test: Adding or updating tests
- [ ] chore: Maintenance tasks

## Services/Components Affected
- [ ] Frontend (Angular)
- [ ] Groups API
- [ ] Profiles API
- [ ] Conferences API
- [ ] Presence API
- [ ] Proxy API Gateway
- [ ] Infrastructure / Bicep
- [ ] Documentation

## How Has This Been Tested?
Describe the tests that you ran to verify your changes.

- [ ] Backend unit tests (`dotnet test src/Attendr.slnx`)
- [ ] Frontend unit tests (`npm test`)
- [ ] Manual testing / local run

## Checklist
- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (e.g., `feat(groups): ...`)
- [ ] Code builds successfully
- [ ] All tests pass locally
- [ ] Coverage results generated (PR workflows produce coverage summaries)
- [ ] Documentation updated (README/docs)
- [ ] No secrets or sensitive data committed
- [ ] Linked related issues
- [ ] Screenshots added for UI changes (if applicable)

## Additional Notes
Add any additional context, screenshots, or design notes.
